# CLI reference

Every command and flag, taken from `chatgpt <command> --help`.

Shared behaviour:

- **Filters.** `--older-than`, `--newer-than`, `--before`, `--after`, `--title`, `--archived`, `--all`, `--limit`, `--suggest`, `--topic` and `--brainstorm` work the same on every command that lists them. They read the local index, so run `chatgpt sync` first.
- **Targets.** Commands that take `[ids...]` accept full ids, unique id prefixes, or `-` to read ids from stdin (the first column of `list` output works).
- **Pinned chats.** Bulk commands skip pinned chats unless you pass `--pinned`.
- **Recommendations.** Preview with `archive --suggest archive --dry-run` or `delete --suggest delete --dry-run`, then repeat without `--dry-run` to apply. Both commands skip unsure `?` chats. Deletion sends up to three requests at a time.
- **Output.** Results go to stdout; progress, prompts and errors go to stderr, so piping `list` into another command stays clean.
- **Exit codes.** `0` on success, `1` when the command fails or any item in a bulk action fails.

## `chatgpt`

```text
Usage: chatgpt [options] [command]

Manage your ChatGPT conversations from the terminal (uses your browser login).

Options:
  --browser <name>                use a specific browser: dia, chrome, safari,
                                  firefox, arc, brave, or edge
  --profile <name>                use a browser profile directory (with
                                  --browser)
  -h, --help                      display help for command

Commands:
  configure [options] [provider]  Store Jev, OpenAI, or Anthropic API keys in
                                  the user config; omit provider to show status
  sync [options]                  Update the local index: new and changed chats,
                                  plus archive state
  list [options]                  List conversations from the local index
  stats [options]                 Chat suggestions, brainstorms and topics, plus
                                  saved-memory suggestions
  memory                          List and delete saved memories, or read the
                                  memory summary
  export|show [options] <link>    Export a conversation as markdown: chat link,
                                  id, or id prefix
  search-index [options]          Build or refresh the local text and semantic
                                  search index
  search [options] <query>        Search the local transcript index; use
                                  --semantic or --hybrid for meaning-based
                                  matches
  project                         List projects and move chats into or out of
                                  them
  archive [options] [ids...]      Archive conversations by id/prefix, `-` for
                                  ids on stdin, or by filter
  unarchive [options] [ids...]    Unarchive conversations by id/prefix, `-` for
                                  ids on stdin, or by filter
  delete [options] [ids...]       Delete conversations by id/prefix, `-` for ids
                                  on stdin, or by filter
  rename [options] <id> <title>   Rename a conversation in ChatGPT (changes its
                                  order in the app)
  title [options] <id> <title>    Set a local display title without changing
                                  ChatGPT
  titles [options] [ids...]       Generate local display titles and topic themes
                                  with gpt-6-luna
  classify [options] [ids...]     Classify with Jev and Luna, then generate
                                  missing local titles and topic themes
  review [options] [ids...]       Triage conversations one by one; changes apply
                                  after a final confirmation
  tui                             Browse, filter and triage conversations in a
                                  terminal UI
  help [command]                  display help for command
```

## `chatgpt configure`

```text
Usage: chatgpt configure [options] [provider]

Store Jev, OpenAI, or Anthropic API keys in the user config; omit provider to
show status

Options:
  --remove    remove the selected provider's stored key
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## `chatgpt sync`

```text
Usage: chatgpt sync [options]

Update the local index: new and changed chats, plus archive state

Options:
  --full      rebuild from scratch (also drops chats deleted in the browser)
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

## `chatgpt list`

```text
Usage: chatgpt list [options]

List conversations from the local index

Options:
  --older-than <age>   last updated more than <age> ago (30d, 12w, 6m, 2y)
  --newer-than <age>   last updated within <age>
  --before <date>      last updated before YYYY-MM-DD
  --after <date>       last updated on or after YYYY-MM-DD
  --title <regex>      title matches regex (case-insensitive)
  --archived           archived conversations instead of active ones
  --all                both active and archived
  --limit <n>          at most n conversations (newest first)
  --suggest <action>   only chats classified as delete, archive, or keep (needs
                       `classify`)
  --topic <topic>      only chats classified in this topic: employer_work,
                       side_projects, coding_general, writing_creativity, faith,
                       family_relationships, health, home_money_admin,
                       career_employment, travel_transport, learning_culture,
                       other
  --brainstorm [kind]  only chats where you were brainstorming; optionally
                       writing, sermon, product, or other
  --json               output JSON
  --format <format>    output format: ids (default: text)
  --count              print only the number of matches
  -h, --help           display help for command
```

## `chatgpt search`

```text
Usage: chatgpt search [options] <query>

Search the local transcript index; use --semantic or --hybrid for meaning-based
matches

Options:
  --semantic         rank by local embedding similarity
  --hybrid           combine full-text and semantic ranking
  --remote           use ChatGPT's server-side search instead
  --archived         search archived conversations instead of active ones
  --all              search both active and archived conversations
  --format <format>  output format: json, csv, table, or ids (default: two-line
                     text)
  --limit <n>        maximum conversations (default: "20")
  -h, --help         display help for command
```

## `chatgpt memory`

```text
Usage: chatgpt memory [options] [command]

List and delete saved memories, or read the memory summary

Options:
  -h, --help                 display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]             List saved memories from ChatGPT
  classify [options]         Classify saved memories for keep, delete, or review
                             with Jev and Luna; never deletes
  summary [options]          Read ChatGPT's generated memory summary
  delete [options] <ids...>  Delete saved memories by id/prefix or `-` for ids
                             on stdin; does not delete source chats
  help [command]             display help for command
```

## `chatgpt memory list`

```text
Usage: chatgpt memory list [options]

List saved memories from ChatGPT

Options:
  --search <text>    only memories whose content contains text
  --limit <n>        at most n saved memories
  --format <format>  output format: json, csv, table, or ids (default: table)
                     (default: "table")
  -h, --help         display help for command
```

## `chatgpt memory classify`

```text
Usage: chatgpt memory classify [options]

Classify saved memories for keep, delete, or review with Jev and Luna; never
deletes

Options:
  --suggest <action>  show only keep, delete, or review
  --limit <n>         at most n results after filtering
  --format <format>   output format: json, csv, table, or ids (default: table)
                      (default: "table")
  --redo              reclassify all saved memories
  -h, --help          display help for command
```

```text
Usage: chatgpt memory summary [options]
```

## `chatgpt memory delete`

```text
Usage: chatgpt memory delete [options] <ids...>

Delete saved memories by id/prefix or `-` for ids on stdin; does not delete
source chats

Options:
  -n, --dry-run  preview without deleting memories
  -y, --yes      skip the confirmation prompt
  -h, --help     display help for command
```

## `chatgpt project`

```text
Usage: chatgpt project [options] [command]

List projects and move chats into or out of them

Options:
  -h, --help                           display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]                       List projects available to your account
  add [options] <project> <ids...>     Move chats into an existing project by
                                       name or id; use `-` for ids on stdin
  remove [options] <project> <ids...>  Remove chats from an existing project;
                                       use `-` for ids on stdin
  help [command]                       display help for command
```

## `chatgpt project list`

```text
Usage: chatgpt project list [options]

List projects available to your account

Options:
  --json       output JSON
  --limit <n>  at most n projects
  -h, --help   display help for command
```

## `chatgpt project add`

```text
Usage: chatgpt project add [options] <project> <ids...>

Move chats into an existing project by name or id; use `-` for ids on stdin

Options:
  -n, --dry-run  preview without moving chats
  -y, --yes      skip the confirmation prompt
  --archived     select archived conversations instead of active ones
  --all          select both active and archived conversations
  -h, --help     display help for command
```

## `chatgpt export`

```text
Usage: chatgpt export|show [options] <link>

Export a conversation as markdown: chat link, id, or id prefix

Options:
  -o, --output [file]  write to a file (default name: from the title)
  -c, --copy           copy to the clipboard
  --archived           allow an archived conversation
  --all                allow either active or archived
  -h, --help           display help for command
```

## `chatgpt classify`

```text
Usage: chatgpt classify [options] [ids...]

Classify with Jev and Luna, then generate missing local titles and topic themes

Options:
  --older-than <age>   last updated more than <age> ago (30d, 12w, 6m, 2y)
  --newer-than <age>   last updated within <age>
  --before <date>      last updated before YYYY-MM-DD
  --after <date>       last updated on or after YYYY-MM-DD
  --title <regex>      title matches regex (case-insensitive)
  --archived           archived conversations instead of active ones
  --all                both active and archived
  --limit <n>          at most n conversations (newest first)
  --suggest <action>   only chats classified as delete, archive, or keep (needs
                       `classify`)
  --topic <topic>      only chats classified in this topic: employer_work,
                       side_projects, coding_general, writing_creativity, faith,
                       family_relationships, health, home_money_admin,
                       career_employment, travel_transport, learning_culture,
                       other
  --brainstorm [kind]  only chats where you were brainstorming; optionally
                       writing, sermon, product, or other
  --pinned             include pinned conversations (skipped by default)
  --redo               re-judge every matching chat, not just new or changed
                       ones (reuses cached transcripts and summaries)
  -y, --yes            don't ask before summarising a large batch
  -h, --help           display help for command
```

## `chatgpt archive`

```text
Usage: chatgpt archive [options] [ids...]

Archive conversations by id/prefix, `-` for ids on stdin, or by filter

Options:
  --older-than <age>   last updated more than <age> ago (30d, 12w, 6m, 2y)
  --newer-than <age>   last updated within <age>
  --before <date>      last updated before YYYY-MM-DD
  --after <date>       last updated on or after YYYY-MM-DD
  --title <regex>      title matches regex (case-insensitive)
  --archived           archived conversations instead of active ones
  --all                both active and archived
  --limit <n>          at most n conversations (newest first)
  --suggest <action>   only chats classified as delete, archive, or keep (needs
                       `classify`)
  --topic <topic>      only chats classified in this topic: employer_work,
                       side_projects, coding_general, writing_creativity, faith,
                       family_relationships, health, home_money_admin,
                       career_employment, travel_transport, learning_culture,
                       other
  --brainstorm [kind]  only chats where you were brainstorming; optionally
                       writing, sermon, product, or other
  --pinned             include pinned conversations (skipped by default)
  -n, --dry-run        show what would change
  -y, --yes            skip the confirmation prompt
  --check              ask Jev to read each chat and only act on those it agrees
                       with (archive/delete)
  -h, --help           display help for command
```
